rec: Crumble undead spell for final boss
rewards: Ability to mine gem rocks in Shilo Village

st.t: Talk to Mosol Rei east of Shilo Village in south Karamja to receive a wampum belt.
s: Why do I need to run?
Rashiliyia? Who is she?
What can we do?
I'll go to see the Shaman.
Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.

st.t: Use the wampum belt on Trufitus, in the north-easternmost house of Tai Bwo Wannai.
s: Mosol Rei said something about a legend?
Do you know anything more about the temple?
Tell me more.
I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!
Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.
Yes.

st.t: From Tai Bwo Wannai, cross the wooden log to the east and head south to the mound of earth surrounded by rocks, south-west of the Shipyard. Use a spade on the mound.
If you only see a mound of earth, look at it first to find the fissure. Then use a lit torch or candle on the fissure. You won't get the light back.
s: Yes

st.t: Use a rope on the fissure.
Long-press the fissure and choose Search.
s: Yes, I'll give it a go!

st.t: Head south from where you landed until you see the water, then go west past the column and search the cave-in to go deeper into the caverns.
s: Yes, I'll wriggle through.

st.t: Search the loose rocks to the north for a tattered scroll.
s: Yes, I'll carefully move the rocks to see what's behind them.

st.t: Head south-east to a small dead-end branch and search the old sacks next to the smashed table for a crumpled scroll.
Long-press the gallows in the north east corner and choose Search to find a corpse.
s: Yes, I may find something else on the corpse.

st.t: Leave the caves: teleport out, or go back through the cave-in, then south and east to the end of the cave and search the rocks there to leave by the waterfall. You can take about 20 damage.
Bury Zadimus's corpse at the Tribal Statue in the middle of Tai Bwo Wannai, west of Trufitus's hut.
Read the tattered scroll.
s: Yes please.

st.t: Read the crumpled scroll.
s: Yes please.

st.t: Go to Cairn Isle, west of Shilo Village, near fairy ring CKR. Climb the rocks (15 Agility) and cross the bridge. Long-press the well stacked rocks on the north side of the island and choose Search.
s: Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!

st.t: Have 3 free inventory spaces. Long-press the tomb dolmen to the south and choose Search. Don't drop the locating crystal.
Use a chisel on the pommel.
Use bronze wire on the beads.

Wear the beads of the dead and go south-east from fairy ring DKP, to the area north of the crashed gnome glider. Search the bright green palm trees from their north side. Come equipped for a boss fight.
i: Crumble undead spell for final boss

st.t: Long-press the carved doors behind the palm trees and choose Search.
Use a chisel on the bone shard.
Use the bone key on the doors behind the palm trees.
Enter the doors behind the palm trees.
Equip the beads of the dead. Go through the gate and down the rocks.
Head west. Don't pick up the stack of coins: it summons undead ones. Then go south, then south-west at the first fork, to the doors at the end.
Long-press your bones, choose Use and tap the doors. Do this for all 3 bones, then enter the room with the beads still on.
Search the tomb dolmen, ready to fight.
Defeat Nazastarool's 3 forms. You can safe spot them over the tomb dolmen. The Crumble Undead spell is very strong against them.
Pickup Rashiliyia's corpse.
Leave the tomb: teleport out, or use the bone key on the doors you came in by. Go back to Cairn Isle, long-press the rocks and choose Search to enter the caverns again.
s: Yes please, I can think of nothing nicer!

st.t: Use Rashiliyia's corpse on the dolmen to the south.

r: Crumble undead spell for final boss
